name: Tidy a Little
description: Tiny tidying ideas that take a minute or two, with no pressure to finish anything.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Tiny tidying ideas for a few minutes away, shown on Away Prompts.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. One small thing is plenty.
howToPlay: Step away and read the idea.
Press Another idea if it does not fit your space.
Press Back at desk when you return.
tips: Ideas are only suggestions. Leave anything that does not suit you.
